method: chr21 genes with RNA detection >= 1% of cells, plus 13 candidate genes, then genes in descending normalized dispersion (all cells) until the transfer estimate reaches the target or max_genes
coordinate_base: BED region = [max(0, start - flank), end + flank); H5AD raw/var start/end are 0-based half-open (verified against SOX2 chr3:181711924-181711925 vs 1-based TSS 181711925), so no 1-based shift is applied
estimator_method: sum over regions of merged tabix chunk byte spans, each costing at least one 262144-byte window, rounded up to whole windows
